schema.description:
A category to be used for reporting emissions specified for each Emission Scope Type within each Inventory Type and Category Type classification, based on existing standards:

* Source: For example, direct/indirect categories from ISO 14064-1, Greenhouse Gas (GHG) Protocol
Categories, Application Programming Interface (API) Compendium, …

* Sink: Specific technology and nature-based solutions (Direct Air Capture (DAC), Carbon Capture and
Storage (CCS), Forestry, Marine, Soil, …)

* Credit: Allowance programs (e.g., Emissions Trading Systems (ETS)), technology and nature-based
credits, Low Carbon Fuel Standard (LCFS) categories
